accepted_current_delta: ActiveAssembly resource boundedness should include explicit model-facing context cost, not item count alone.
Global ancestry caps are not frozen target semantics because a constructed concentrated-family counterexample suppressed distinct necessary facts.
Provenance/ancestry remains useful anti-echo evidence but should be tested against claim-local or set-level redundancy mechanisms.
integration_with_this_run: ActiveAssembly context budget constrains cognitive/model-facing evidence only; execution authority, effect_operation_id, semantic_fingerprint, dispatch/recovery state and authoritative OutcomeReceipt/UNCERTAIN state must remain durable runtime/UnifiedDB semantics and must not be evictable by model-context selection.
The four-way effect boundary remains unchanged: cognitive consistency, effect-time freshness, execution authority and outcome certainty/recoverability are distinct.

Ancestry/provenance should inform both ActiveAssembly anti-echo selection and negative-result applicability lineage, but neither domain should freeze a universal global ancestry quota without discriminating evidence.
A future H1 Golden Trace must bind the exact ActiveAssembly identity/context-cost receipt to EffectIntent while separately preserving effect/recovery identity across crash/retry.
new_counterhypothesis: A single unified model-facing packet envelope can safely carry both cognitive evidence and authoritative effect/recovery state under one budget/selection policy.
falsifier_for_current_separation: Matched crash/retry and context-pressure trials show that allowing authority/recovery metadata to participate in ordinary ActiveAssembly eviction/selection never loses reconciliation identity, never changes authorization, and yields lower total complexity/cost without semantic divergence.
claim_limit: The source benchmark is synthetic/hosted; it changes current architecture hypotheses but does not establish target-host or local-4B superiority.
